title: curcuma oligantha var. lutea
intro: Curcuma oligantha var. lutea, commonly known as a type of plant in the ginger family, is a variant of the Curcuma oligantha species. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Curcuma oligantha var. lutea include analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-cancer effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents. The plant's bioactive constituents include curcuminoids, gingerols, and shogaols, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
